content:
Maria: CI red on main after merge — mypy failing in inference/kvcache.py shard. Tests are green locally for me. Can someone kick a rerun and help bisect? @eng-oncall @ci-bot :eyes:
Ashok: Which job/shard? paste the error snippet?
Maria: job=typecheck-mypy #1123 shard=7
Maria: ```
inference/kvcache.py:241: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "CacheState")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 128 source files)
```
Jen: sounds like the Optional->non-Optional narrowing we've seen. Did any typing-stub PR land recently? :thinking_face:
Omar: I can trigger an isolated rerun of that shard: `mage ci rerun --job 1123 --shard 7`
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Omar for job=1123 shard=7 — queued (build 1123.2) :robot_face:
Ashok: while it runs, try `mypy inference/kvcache.py --show-traceback` locally and also with `--strict-optional` to match CI flags
Maria: running local mypy with the CI args now. If it fails, I'll paste full trace.
ci-bot: Build 1123.2 started — logs: https://ci.example.org/build/1123.2
Maria: local mypy reproduces the error when I run with `--no-implicit-optional` — weird, I thought repo uses implicit optional?
Jen: that suggests a config drift or a new stub change. Omar can we bisect recent commits affecting typing/ stubs?
Omar: I can do a quick git-bisect against the last 20 commits on main: `git bisect start -- HEAD $(git rev-parse HEAD~20)` then `git bisect run ./scripts/mypy-check.sh`
Ashok: heads-up: scripts/mypy-check.sh uses the same flags as CI, so bisect should be accurate.
ci-bot: Build 1123.2 finished — FAILED (same error). Logs: https://ci.example.org/build/1123.2/log
Maria: thanks — Omar can you kick the bisect? I have a couple of changes locally so I don't want to bork main.
Omar: starting bisect now, will report first bad commit. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jen: if bisect points to a typeshed/stub bump, we should revert the stub in a patch to unblock other PRs and open a follow-up to fix properly.
Omar: first pass says bad commit is `a7c9d2` (typing/stubs: tighten Optional on kvcache interfaces).  Going to double-check with a manual mypy run on that commit.
Ashok: if that's the one, feels like a policy/compatibility issue. We should add a short note to the release notes and notify infra teams.
Omar: manual run confirms `a7c9d2` introduces the failure. I'll prepare a revert PR and ping reviewers.
Maria: awesome, thanks. Can someone do an expedited rerun of CI once revert is merged? I'll hold off merges until then. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Revert PR created by Omar: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2356 — request: run full CI.
Jen: I'll queue a priority CI run on the revert once it's merged and monitor the typecheck shard.
Maria: leaving a note in the PR that this is blocking merges — tagging core-owners.
Omar: PR merged, queued priority CI: https://ci.example.org/build/1123.3
ci-bot: Build 1123.3 started — priority queue.
ci-bot: Build 1123.3 finished — SUCCESS. typecheck-mypy shard 7 passed.
Maria: confirmed green. marking this resolved and unblocking merges. I'll open a follow-up issue to fix the stricter stubs properly. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
